references.text: Jacob named the place Bethel, but the city was formerly called Luz. This verse explains the connection between the names Bethel and Luz mentioned in Joshua 16:2.
Jacob came to Luz in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel. This confirms the identification of Luz with Bethel as a boundary point.
The house of Joseph took Bethel, which was formerly called Luz. This provides historical background for why Bethel/Luz was an important boundary marker for the tribe of Joseph.
Benjamin's border toward Luz, that is, Bethel, is described here. This shows that Bethel/Luz was a shared boundary point between Ephraim and Benjamin.
Ephraim's eastern border at Ataroth-Addar is mentioned, which has a connection to Ataroth (the territory of the Arkites) in verse 2.
